name: etf_exposures
purpose: Construct dated, source-bound fund identity and reported equity-exposure observations, including missing weights and derivative/lending caveats, before runtime integration.
availability: Each report becomes usable at 00:00 Asia/Shanghai on the first observed session strictly after the later of its catalogue and delivery dates. This is a retrospective convention; exact historical intraday publication and unchanged past bytes are uncertified.

At each information time select the greatest known reporting-period end. For the same period prefer the later available annual/interim full schedule over the quarterly partial schedule. Publication of an older-period report cannot overwrite newer-period observations. Keep all superseded sources.
Fund summary identity is the latest observation strictly before the session, no earlier than its preparation date. A known benchmark name does not establish continuous unchanged constituents.

CAPCO matching uses the latest release available at that information time. Alias correspondence can only come from already available identity sources; do not use future classification or future aliases. Carry neither omitted stocks nor absent financial fields from older sources.
Preserve report age and incomplete holdings explicitly; do not claim current portfolios, actual daily exposure or real execution availability. No performance-based freshness rule is permitted.
field_review: Reuse frozen stock, sector, asset and NAV cells without rewriting them. Extract additional financial-note pages from the same accepted PDFs, never from the rejected truncated copy.

Review all 528 reports for stock-index futures, treasury futures, warrants, stock options, other derivative holdings and security-lending treatment. Annual/interim derivative notes outside the portfolio chapter are in scope.

Preserve whole relevant section boundaries, report dates, table headers, units, long/short signs, quantity, contract notional and fair value separately. Margin, fair value or P&L is not contract notional. A policy statement or missing table is not a zero position.

Require independent PDF readers and ordered row/code checks for extracted contract cells; visually inspect ambiguous layouts and every accepted cross-page correction. Preserve all failures and original source defects.

Preserve exact absence clauses with context; ambiguous or unreviewed clauses remain unknown. Lending must not be added twice when included in the equity schedule; absence of an inclusion statement does not certify it.
mapping: Join each explicitly reported six-digit stock code to the current available CAPCO inventory, then only an unambiguous available one-to-one alias. Preserve unmatched identifiers, amount and cause.

Use exact reported market values divided by the independently reviewed reported NAV. Keep integer/decimal inputs and rational numerators/denominators; reported rounded percentages are validation fields, not normalized portfolio weights.
Keep the source A-S sector table distinct from CAPCO divisions. Do not map a coarse category to a finer division without security-level evidence.

Store named matched stocks, named unmatched stocks, undisclosed stock amount (sector-stock total minus named holdings), signed equity/sector residual, derivatives and non-equity assets separately. Never renormalize partial holdings, fill omissions with zero, allocate residuals to cash/industries or net derivative positions without evidence.

Derive future portfolio-proxy bounds only from reviewed positions and explicitly disclosed notional values; any unbounded/unknown component remains a blocker for claiming complete economic exposure. Report-date NAV ratios applied to market-valued ETF positions are a modelling convention, not certified daily look-through exposure.
validation: Every fund has distinct, ordered information boundaries and complete source identities; repeated reports are not duplicate positions.

Independently rebuild direct/alias joins and exact amount partitions without calling the production lookup. All partitions reconcile, original source cells remain exact, all unmatched weights remain visible.

Check before-first-release, same-day exclusion, holiday-delayed boundaries, later older-period publications, partial/full same-period replacement, missing classifications, aliases, duplicate/sleeve codes and negative residuals.

Truncating future sources or perturbing later reports/classifications cannot alter earlier histories. Document coverage across the full active calendar without using returns, forecasts or held-position selection.
integration_gate: Register coverage, fund identity/grouping and reported look-through exposure controls before modifying runtime inputs. Require old-input compatibility, full retraining/reloads, independent full accounts, paper-account parity and status/plan binding checks. Source review itself changes neither training inputs nor active plans; unknown economic exposure cannot be called resolved by identity grouping.
constraints: Balanced attack; 8 percent warning; original high-water mark; latched non-recovering risk
positive_score adoption, legacy turnover; exhausted candidate budget and adoption thresholds unchanged
Competition whitepaper authoritative; fees and matching still unconfirmed
No APP, broker account or WeChat actions; no fabricated fills or forward returns
